fusions.name: Antler Pick
fusions.desc: Strikes the target, which deals 8 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Over the Ha-Ha
fusions.desc: Bounds you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then lands, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Park Paling
fusions.desc: Raises a wall 5 tiles long in front of you that blocks movement for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: A Brick Per Miss
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
